task.description: Enable backend runtime prerequisite for OBS-04 browser E2E validation. Ensure the application launched via project run target provides a persistent API server process suitable for Playwright UI->API->DB flow verification, instead of exiting immediately after startup. Implement minimal safe changes in backend runtime/entrypoint wiring required for this. Preserve existing security and error-set constraints, and validate using backend build/test/run checks.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime target starts and remains available for E2E interaction
No regression in zig build and zig build test
Changes are minimal and documented in handoff artifacts
Any constraints preventing full enablement are clearly reported with severity

result.summary: Implemented runtime prerequisite fix for OBS-04 by replacing immediate process exit in src/main.zig with a persistent Zig 0.16-compatible HTTP listener. zig build, zig build test, and zig build migrate all pass; zig build run now stays active and responds 200 on /health/live.

issues.description: Runtime availability prerequisite is satisfied, but non-health API paths currently return HTTP 501 placeholder responses; full browser UI->API->DB verification still requires route wiring beyond this minimal runtime patch.

result.next_action: Route to TEST-RUNNER for runtime-prerequisite re-validation, then plan follow-up backend API server wiring for full browser UI->API->DB E2E closure if still required.
